def: A benchmark that compares data-curation methods by training models on a fixed 240T-token Common Crawl pool; its DCLM-Baseline dataset relies on model-based quality filtering.
practice: DCLM-Baseline trained a 7B model to 64% five-shot MMLU on 2.6T tokens and makes up 3.71T of the 3.90T tokens in OLMo 2's pretraining mix.
